key_concepts: Electromagnetic radiation includes radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultra
Electromagnetic waves have wavelength, frequency, and energy
Radio waves are used in telecommunications such as radio and TV broadcasting
Microwaves are used in satellite communication
X-rays are used in medical diagnostic imaging and CT scans
Gamma rays are used in cancer treatment and sterilization
Electromagnetic radiation can be ionizing or non-ionizing
Ionizing radiation can have harmful effects on living things
Practical applications of electromagnetic radiation must be weighed against potential risk
